note.title: Assessment Practice — speaking and conversation rehearsal
note.overview: Typed rehearsal for the school-listed conversation and authentic-spoken-French skills. Say each response aloud before typing it.
learningGoals: Develop an answer with a reason.
Use formal and informal address appropriately.
Move between past, present and future in conversation.
mustMemoriseRules: Age uses avoir: j’ai treize ans.
A developed answer adds a detail or reason.
If you do not understand, use a repair phrase instead of freezing.
For past habits use the imperfect; for completed events use the perfect.
workedExamples: D’accord, pourquoi pas ? J’aime le cinéma parce que c’est amusant.
Quand j’étais plus jeune, je jouais au tennis. Maintenant, j’écoute plus de musique.
commonMistakes: Giving a one-word answer when the task asks you to develop.
Using tu in a formal role-play.
Mixing perfect and imperfect without a meaning reason.
Typing silently instead of saying the response aloud first.
detailedExplanation: This is an app-built assessment-practice topic. The curriculum scope is verified against the official Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 French Curriculum Outline 2026-27.

Where the school outline names an assessment, it does not publish the teacher’s exact live paper or complete mark scheme. This app therefore practises the verified skills without claiming to reproduce the teacher’s paper.
French accents are corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the mark in this app.
The school outline verifies conversation/authentic spoken-French outcomes. This bank is a typed speaking rehearsal; it is not presented as a school speaking examination or teacher mark scheme.
examTips: Underline the time clue before choosing a tense.
Answer every bullet before adding ambitious detail.
Use accurate short sentences rather than risky long sentences.
quickCheck: Develop an answer with a reason.
Use formal and informal address appropriately.
beforeStartingPractice: Do the first attempt without notes. Use the explanation only after submitting.
